issues.summary: Setup's two 20s waitFor calls (40s worst case) exceed the 30s Maestro ready-marker gate
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: draftEditorsSetup.ts:33-34 gives POLL_ATTEMPTS 40 × 500ms = 20s per wait, and there are two waits in sequence (lines 63-64). approval-editor.yml:19-22 waits only draftNetworkTimeout=30000 (defaults.js:6). The budgets really are misaligned, but chain config and the SDK normally resolve fast, so this only bites on a very slow network.

issues.summary: The waitFor timeout/failure branch (chain config or SDK never arriving) has no unit test
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: draftEditorsSetup.test.ts:15-23 mocks selectChainById and getSafeSDK to return values straight away. Only the compose-rejects failure is tested (lines 82-87), so the 'timed out waiting for' throw at draftEditorsSetup.ts:44 never runs. This is e2e-only harness code, so the impact is small.

issues.summary: verify-details-nonce asserts the copied nonce appears anywhere on the details screen, not on the Nonce row
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: verify-details-nonce.yml:27 uses `assertVisible: '${maestro.copiedText}'` with no id or row scoping. A small recommended nonce could match other numeric fields such as zero-valued gas fields, so the second check in send-nonce-editor.yml could pass falsely. The 99999 case is safe.

issues.summary: Owner/spender addresses are hardcoded instead of being derived from mockedActiveSafeInfo.owners, as connectSignerSetup does
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: draftEditorsSetup.ts:20,25 hardcode values that are identical to mockData.ts:23-24. connectSignerSetup.ts:20 uses `mockedActiveSafeInfo.owners[0].value`, and the test at line 59 repeats the literal again. Several copies could drift if the fixture changes.

issues.summary: The spender address is duplicated as hand-encoded hex inside APPROVE_DATA
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: draftEditorsSetup.ts:28-31 embeds `81bdb0a6…14fec` as hex next to SPENDER_ADDRESS at line 25. Building the calldata with encodeFunctionData would keep one source of truth. This is a small maintainability cost.

issues.summary: Setup marker never resets to idle between runs
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: setupHelpers.ts (resetReduxForE2E) now calls `draftEditorsE2eState.reset()`, and setupApprovalDraft runs setupSendFlow→resetReduxForE2E before it sets any status. The reset is explicit, not a side effect of call order.

issues.summary: The review-and-confirm-button testID is added but no flow in this PR uses it
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: A grep for 'review-and-confirm-button' under apps/mobile/e2e finds nothing, so the testID added in ReviewFooter.tsx:38 is unused in this diff. It is harmless and additive.

issues.summary: resetReduxForE2E is mocked, so real store state leaks between unit tests
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: draftEditorsSetup.test.ts:9-13 mocks resetReduxForE2E to a no-op while the tests use the real `store`, so signer and activeSigner state persists across tests. Nothing fails today because every test writes the same values.

issues.summary: accessible={false} on the overlay Pressable removes tap-outside dismiss for screen readers
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: DialogModal.tsx:32 sets accessible={false} on the overlay, so assistive tech no longer exposes it as an actionable element. Cancel and the modal's own dismiss still exist, and the change fixes a real grouping bug, so the tradeoff is minor. It is also not mentioned in the PR.

issues.summary: The 99999 custom nonce assumes the staging Safe's nonce stays below it
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: send-nonce-editor.yml:93 inputs 99999. A test Safe on staging reaching that nonce is very unlikely, so there is no practical cost.

issues.summary: The unit test mocks RTK Query initiate() instead of using MSW
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: draftEditorsSetup.test.ts:30-45 stubs `safesGetSafeV1.initiate`. This departs from the MSW guidance, but the setup is e2e harness code and other tests use the same pattern.

issues.summary: The spender regex only checks the prefix and suffix
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: verify-approve-amount.yml:35 matches '.*0x81Bd.*4fec.*' against a fixed, known spender. A collision on the action detail screen is not realistic.

issues.summary: The scroll-to-and-tap edit-approval-button block is duplicated in approval-editor.yml
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: approval-editor.yml:38-44 and 69-75 repeat the same few steps. This is a style preference.

issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: draftEditorsSetup.ts:38 `if (value)` is fine for both current callers, which return objects. The risk is only to hypothetical future callers.

issues.summary: Mixed use of the passed dispatch and store.dispatch
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: draftEditorsSetup.ts:62 has a comment explaining that store.dispatch is used on purpose for the typed AppDispatch. Switching to it everywhere is a stylistic choice.

issues.summary: The setupSendFlow test doesn't assert navigation
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: The test mocks onboardAndNavigate (test.ts:12), so router.replace is never reached. Navigation belongs to the shared helper, and this test is about seeding the signer.
